note: Fitness (Dave 2026-10-21): a character attribute, a whole number min to max (-10 to +10), 0 an average adult, that directly sets how fast exertion rises during strenuous activity (running, climbing, tool work, heavy loads): the rise per second is multiplied by exp(-fitness x strength), so +10 fitness at strength 0.05 raises exertion at about 61 percent of the normal pace (winded after about 1.65 times as long) and -10 at about 165 percent. Falling (recovery) is not touched. It is stored with the character in characters.json like luck. New characters start at default. Training (Dave 2026-10-21: starts fixed, trains slowly): the creation value is the base; every winded_s_per_point seconds spent over-exerted adds a point (up to max_gain above the base), and every decay_s_per_point seconds not winded takes one back, never below the base. set_fitness() sets the base and clears the training. Set strength to 0 to switch fitness off.
